scientific_question: Among independently surveyed marine reef sites, how many year-to-year same-site sampling opportunities were specifically assessed using Method 1 fish transects? This is a survey-effort gate, NOT observed fish colonization.

source.fish_method: Method 1: 50 m transect, 5m wide swath in 2 distinct blocks; method 0 is off-transect and must not fill sampled-negative.

survey_restrictions.program: RLS only; ATRC and OTHER have separately reported counts but no mixing with primary RLS hypotheses
survey_restrictions.method1_present: methods contains integer token 1 split from comma/space lists; 13 or 12 alone must NOT be interpreted as method 1
survey_restrictions.unit: source survey_id (one 50m transect); one site-month-year must have >=2 distinct method1 survey IDs
survey_restrictions.study_group: program+country+area+location from official metadata; names are NOT verified island polygons
survey_restrictions.site: normalized country|area|location|site_code; must have coordinate span <=0.01 latitude and longitude degrees
survey_restrictions.temporal: calendar month exactly equal and consecutive years; >=2 transects with method1 on each side; >=3 distinct surveyed years at >=5 sites; >=10 strict site-month adjacent-year pairs across >=2 distinct prior years

reporting.survey_program_counts: Report RLS, ATRC and OTHER source surveys both before/after method 1 filtering, no personal or survey IDs
reporting.candidate_counts: Report all TEN frozen RLS candidate groups regardless of whether strict method1 repeat survey support succeeds
reporting.eligibility_exclusion: No method1, no stable site code, or monthly year match missing = no fish survey frame; do not impute sample absence.
